provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Pandemic Legacy: Season 0 rulebook (Z-Man Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Draw and read Legacy deck cards aloud until one says PAUSE or STOP; prepare the month's objectives
A safehouse in each city with a permanent safehouse (Washington at first); Threat Level marker on the leftmost space
Shuffle the Threat cards: flip 3 and put 3 agents in each city, 3 more with 2 agents, 3 more with 1 agent
Add Event cards equal to your funding level (5 at the start) to the City cards and shuffle
Split the rest into 5 piles, 1 Escalation card shuffled into each; stack them left to right, smaller piles at the bottom
Each player picks a character: pawn, Reference card and passport, then an alias
Apply any rule stickers already placed in the setup steps
All pawns start in Washington; pick a pawn at random to take the first turn
